programmes.d: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

When a bank teller arrived at her parent's home the gunmen were already there. The robbers held her family hostage and forced her to empty a bank vault. If she didn't comply she could lose everyone she loved.
When gangs go to war, they don't care who gets in the way. In 1988 an innocent man was gunned down near Cleveland, Ohio, a victim of a deadly initiation.
While camping with her family in Montana, a seven-year-old girl was abducted from her tent. No one in the campground witnessed the crime and the kidnapper left no clues.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programmes.d: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

Historien begynder da en ekspedition ankommer til øen Bengalla på jagt efter Tugandas legendariske kranier. Disse kranier menes at besidde en energi med enorme kræfter, der kan betyde en katastrofe for hele menneskeheden.

Roland Sallinger (STEVEN SEAGAL) bliver ringet op af en desperat Conner Wellls; hans tidligere kollega fra S.W.A.T.-styrken. Hensynsløse kriminelle har i et forsøg på at kidnappe Conners datter, Nikita, efterladt et voldsomt blodbad.
Mestertyven Will Montgomery (Nicolas Cage) bliver løsladt efter at have siddet fængslet i 10 år for et spektakulært indbrud med et gigantisk udbytte.
En tidligere straffet tager et job med at køre en lastbil tværs over landet. Den er imidlertid fyldt med våben, og han må kæmpe for at redde sin familie og overleve.

Gene kommer hjem efter at have deltaget i sin ekskones begravelse. Snart efter bliver hans datter bortført. Han får en pistol og får at vide, at hans datter bliver dræbt, hvis han ikke har slået en vis person ihjel inden for en time og et kvarter.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programmes.d: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programmes.d: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.
Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programmes.d: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.
Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programmes.d: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.
In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.
